faq.q: When will the new rates for January-March 2027 be announced?
faq.a: The Ministry of Finance usually announces the revised rates for the upcoming quarter by the end of the current quarter. So, the rates for January-March 2027 are expected to be announced around late December 2026.
Yes, small savings schemes are considered very safe as they are backed by the Government of India, offering a sovereign guarantee.

faq.q: Can I invest in any of these schemes online?
faq.a: Many banks and post offices now offer online account opening and management for some small savings schemes like PPF and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana. You should check with your specific bank or post office.

faq.q: Do these schemes offer tax benefits?
faq.a: Many popular small savings schemes like PPF, NSC, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, and the 5-year Post Office Time Deposit offer tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, up to the prescribed limits. Interest earned on PPF and SSY is also tax-exempt.

faq.q: How does the interest calculation work for schemes like PPF?
faq.a: For PPF, interest is calculated monthly on the lowest balance between the 5th and the last day of each month, but it is credited to the account at the end of the financial year.
